description: A signpost: where one exit of a web tile leads (ways between tiles, thunderbird.cafe, v 1; see cafe.thunderbird.way.place). The tile names its signpost in its /ways.json; only a host (the page that holds the tile) reads it, since a tile can't reach the network. Change it any time: the tile never has to be republished.

main.description: The record key is the tile's id and the exit's id, joined by a dot (e.g. "maze.obelisk").

to.description: Where the exit leads. Empty: dormant, it leads nowhere yet. One: straight there. Several: the host offers a choice ("pick a door").

note.description: A line the host can show, e.g. "Under construction".

destination.description: Exactly one of place or tile.

place.description: A place record (cafe.thunderbird.way.place): the usual case.

tile.description: A tile record (ing.dasl.masl), for a tile with no place record.

entrance.description: Which entrance to arrive at, as named in that tile's /ways.json.

label.description: A label for the choice, when there are several.
